config.written_before_results: Written by entry 51 before any result. A one-time exception to entry 48's one-attempt rule, made so that what could ship gets measured; no further team variants follow, whatever the result. No new logic, prompt or threshold: the arm is the two pieces entries 48 and 49 already wrote.
config.new_set_labels: The labels of the new set (scenarios_extra) are unreviewed by a person. An agent's read of at least 30 of them is a separate step under entry 51 and does not make them reviewed.
config.entry_51_rule_looks_at: Entry 51's rule for T9.1's primary looks at `team_shipping_changed` (not `team_changed`, which cannot ship as measured) on the new set (scenarios_extra), which must beat `single` on the written score under both the local and the cloud judge. This record has the local judge only; the cloud grader's half comes from the judge check, so this record decides nothing.
config.run_conditions: cards ran as the only GPU job on the machine, by an exclusive hold, while cloud grading through a CPU-only subprocess and other projects' CPU work may have been running; the session closed during judging, so judging ran later from the saved rows at the same commit; the arms it is compared with ran in an earlier session, so latency is not a clean measurement

devices.note: from the Ollama process list right after each model loaded; unknown means it did not say

config.same_for_all: the writer, retrieval config, cases, deadline and local judge model of the E3T records named in cross_record.source_records; the arm adds a PromptedChecker on the writer and memory_gap_abstains
config.change: memory_gap_abstains: when the memory specialist's first pass finished cleanly with no finding, the card abstains and the other findings are withheld (saved in drops with reason memory_empty). Nothing else differs from `team`.
config.hypothesis: How the team merges its specialists loses their 'not enough evidence' signal: memory returns no finding when the turns do not support one, but any finding from the other specialist makes the card answered.
config.score: score = mean(grounded_rate, min(answer_when_answerable, abstain_when_insufficient)); every part must be defined; ties go to lower median latency, then to the order of CARD_SYSTEMS

cross_record.note: The other systems' rows are the saved rows of the E3T records named in `source_records`, loaded from disk. A record's comparisons must name two systems of that record, so every comparison, score and twin table that sets this arm beside the others is here, recomputed from those rows and this record's rows. They were run in an earlier session: timing and load differ, and the judge model is the same one.
